# Claude Code Slack Bot (`mpociot-claude-code-slack-bot`)

Boost productivity with Claude Code Slack Bot! Get AI-driven coding assistance right in Slack. Chat in threads, stream responses, and keep context seamlessly across messages. Transform your coding workflow today!

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-Claude-Code-Slackbot.html) · [Source](https://github.com/mpociot/claude-code-slack-bot)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "mpociot-claude-code-slack-bot"
  name       = "mybot"

  parameters = {
    SlackBotToken        = "..."
    SlackAppToken        = "..."
    SlackSigningSecret   = "..."
    AnthropicApiKey      = "..."
    # GithubAppId          = "..."
    # GithubPrivateKey     = "..."
    # GithubInstallationId = "..."
    # GithubToken          = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SlackBotToken` | string | yes |  |
| `SlackAppToken` | string | yes |  |
| `SlackSigningSecret` | string | yes |  |
| `AnthropicApiKey` | string | yes |  |
| `GithubAppId` | string | no |  |
| `GithubPrivateKey` | string | no |  |
| `GithubInstallationId` | string | no |  |
| `GithubToken` | string | no |  |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
